descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-01 Patient Chart Card · S14 「两个同姓的病人：点哪张卡片就打开哪一个」 Two patients sharing a last name: the tapped card opens exactly that one

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U7 Tapping a card opens that exact patient's Pre-Round view.（UAT TC-01；TFA-92579 AC 5）
  • U8 With multiple patients loaded, everything above holds in both Hospital and Nursing Home.（UAT TC-01；UAT 3.3）

测试设计方法：错误推测（error-guessing） — 专门去撞最容易出错的地方（失败、重复点、两个标签页、时钟不对、注入的指令）。

Given seededCensus H1 'Ana Rivera' (412) and H2 'Ben Rivera' (415); N1 'Dora Nguyen' and N2 'Hoa Nguyen'

When Sort by name, search the shared last name, tap the second card, go back, tap the first; same in Nursing Home

Then Each chart header shows the tapped patient's own name and room, never the neighbour's

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：oracle.mjs: each chart checkpoint mustContain the tapped name (+ room for Hospital) and 'Admission status' (chart header only, so a list filtered to one card cannot pass), and mustNotContain the other name

在哪跑：dev 单元 U27；测试方法 AGENT · 浏览器 agent；矩阵里排的车道 浏览器 agent（blocked）

S14 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-01.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：dev — dev 部署，build e02167f（Deploy Convex，2026-10-12T18:24:27Z）；账号和地址不写进报告；run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev。

测试方法：AGENT · 浏览器 agent；辅助：PW · Playwright 脚本 — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 both 跑；来源：dev。

UAT item: TC-01 Patient Chart Card · Section: A1 · Home Screen & Dashboard · Scenario: TC-01/S14

Two patients sharing a last name: the tapped card opens exactly that one

Tickets: TFA-92579 Home Screen: Patient Chart Card (ready for qa)

Result: Pass from scripts/oracle.mjs on the saved evidence (units/U27.verdict.json), unit U27 split by its parts' checkpoints. Agent: 95 turns, 346 s, $0.81.

Plan: unit U27 (#27, ready-for-qa, ui-only) — Card fields and day counts, seeded identities. S03 and S14 have the same seed; S05 seeds the same Ana and Ben Rivera rows plus five more Hospital patients, so one union seed serves all three. Each part isolates its card by searching its name; S05's rounding:list count (7 Hospital rows) is exactly the union's Hospital rows. Runs together with TC-01/S03, TC-01/S05.

Checked by Quinn's runner (ledger.md #27, U27; checked: yes): Fail (S03, S05 — product, cluster C2) — UAT TC-01 / TFA-92579 AC 3–4: card shows '76y' (no sex, not '76F') and no hospital day / visit number (some show 'New today'); NH card also shows the diagnosis (C1). S14 (chart header, '—' for missing data, nothing invented) passes
